versions.changelog:
**Changelog for pushplus-notification v1.3.6**

- Updated pushplus OpenAPI version to 1.20.
- Clarified and enhanced QQ bot support documentation: now explicitly includes user self-owned robots and behavior for not providing `option`.
- Improved and expanded descriptions for QQ bot and channel behavior in both API parameter tables and usage sections.
- Minor corrections to channel option usage notes.
- Removed the unused file: skill-card.md.

- Added support for 新消息ClawBot (cmcc) channel, enabling notifications to be sent via China Mobile 5G Messaging; requires prior binding of Channel API Key.
- Updated documentation to reflect API version upgrades (now based on API v1.18/openApi v1.19).
- Improved instructions for using 新消息ClawBot, including setup and sample usage.
- Cleaned up repository by removing the sample file skill-card.md.

pushplus-notification v1.3.4

- Added support for managing and configuring message forward rules via Open API.
- Updated description and documentation to include message rule configuration alongside existing features.
- Usage instructions and flow now mention configuring message rules where relevant.
- Removed the sample skill-card.md file.

- Added support for QQ bot notifications, including sending to personal QQ via bot or to QQ groups via channel option.
- Updated documentation to cover new QQ bot and QQ group features, parameters, and usage examples.
- Bumped API and open API versions to 1.17.
- Removed obsolete sample card file (skill-card.md).

Version 1.3.2 brings documentation updates for new pushplus features and cleans up sample files.

- Updated documentation to support new templates: push 文档 (doc) and push 表格 (excel), including usage examples.
- Added details for blacklists and managing friend/topic-user blacklists in pushplus API use cases.
- Clarified callback and status handling in message delivery and open API.
- Incremented Open API version to 1.16 for up-to-date compatibility.
- Removed obsolete sample file skill-card.md.

Version 1.3.1 of pushplus-notification

- Updated documentation and interface descriptions to match pushplus HTTP API v1.16.
- Added ClawBot, App, and multi-channel support in descriptions and usage.
- Expanded information on managing send results, topics, friends, and advanced Open API scenarios (now referenced in reference.md).
- SKILL.md improved with detailed parameter explanations, new request options, and extra safety cautions.
- Added reference.md; removed outdated skill-card.md.
- Example curl commands and workflows revised for accuracy and clarity.

Version 1.1.0 — security and environment management improvements.

- Added explicit security requirements: require user confirmation before sending, warn on sensitive content, and never display or store full tokens.
- Updated token extraction: from .env, extract only the PUSHPLUS_TOKEN line to avoid leaking unrelated credentials.
- Documented required environment variable with a new requiredEnvVars section.
- Clarified .env usage and minimum read principle to enhance security.
- Incremented version metadata to 1.1.0.

Initial release: Send push notifications via pushplus HTTP API

- Supports sending notifications to WeChat, email, webhook, SMS, and more using curl/Shell.
- No external dependencies required; only needs a PUSHPLUS_TOKEN.
- Instructions for both single and bulk message sending.
- Includes customizable templates and channels.
- Details usage, parameter options, sample commands, and best practices.
- Clear guidance on token handling and security.
